name: Dream Health Chain
rootCause: Dream Health Chain’s staking/reward contracts on BSC were exploited for about 71,851 USDT. A broken award state machine allowed a claimed reward to be reset with a tiny or zero-effective DHC deposit, so the same fixed payout could be claimed repeatedly from the shared pool. The attacker looped pledge and claim, then sold about 542,070 DHC into the DHC-USDT pool.

descriptions.text: Dream Health Chain’s staking/reward contracts on BSC were exploited for about 71,851 USDT. A broken award state machine allowed a claimed reward to be reset with a tiny or zero-effective DHC deposit, so the same fixed payout could be claimed repeatedly from the shared pool. The attacker looped pledge and claim, then sold about 542,070 DHC into the DHC-USDT pool.

Dream Health Chain lost about $71,800 on 2026-09-05 after an award state machine let a claimed reward be reset and paid again from a shared proxy balance on BNB Chain's BSC network. The award workflow lacked per-award reserve locking and let participateAward() restore a claimed award to an unclaimed state, so claimAward() could pay the same fixed reward repeatedly from a shared proxy balance.
